name: eu-ai-act
title: EU AI Act readiness
note: Control mappings are the author's reading of each provision, written to make engineering readiness checkable. They are not legal advice and do not decide what a regulation requires of you. Check the text and your counsel, and edit this file to match their view.

controls.title: No prohibited practice applies
controls.remedy: Record a screen of the system against each Article 5 practice, with the reviewer and the reasoning, and set values.none_apply only if none applies.

controls.title: Risk classification recorded and reasoned
controls.remedy: Classify the system against Annex III and Article 6(3), write down the reasoning, and set system.risk_class.

controls.title: Risk management system
controls.remedy: Keep a risk management process that covers foreseeable misuse, residual risk and its acceptance, and review it on a schedule.

controls.title: Data and data governance
controls.requires: present(evidence.data_governance) and evidence.data_governance.values.provenance_documented == true and evidence.data_governance.values.representativeness_assessed == true and evidence.data_governance.values.bias_examined == true
controls.remedy: Document where training, validation and test data came from, whether it represents the people affected, and how bias in it was examined.

controls.title: Bias examination with a result
controls.remedy: Run `python -m lex_machine bias` on predictions with the protected attribute and record the result. An inconclusive result does not pass.

controls.title: Technical documentation (Annex IV)
controls.remedy: Assemble the Annex IV documentation and keep it current with each release.

controls.title: Automatic logging, kept at least six months
controls.requires: present(evidence.logging) and evidence.logging.values.automatic_logging == true and evidence.logging.values.retention_days >= 180
controls.remedy: Log events automatically over the system's life and retain the logs for at least 180 days.

controls.title: Instructions for use for deployers
controls.remedy: Provide deployers with instructions covering purpose, accuracy, limits, oversight needs and known risks.

controls.title: Human oversight
controls.remedy: Design and record the oversight measures, including how a person can intervene, override or stop the system.

controls.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
controls.requires: present(evidence.accuracy_robustness) and evidence.accuracy_robustness.values.accuracy_declared == true and evidence.accuracy_robustness.values.robustness_tested == true and evidence.accuracy_robustness.values.cybersecurity_tested == true
controls.remedy: Declare accuracy metrics and test robustness and cybersecurity against the declared levels.

controls.title: Quality management system
controls.remedy: Put a documented quality management system in place that covers design, testing, data and post-market handling.

controls.title: Conformity assessment completed
controls.remedy: Complete the applicable conformity assessment procedure before placing the system on the market.

controls.title: EU declaration of conformity
controls.remedy: Draw up and keep the EU declaration of conformity.

controls.title: Registration in the EU database
controls.remedy: Register the system in the EU database before it is placed on the market or put into service.

controls.title: Post-market monitoring plan
controls.remedy: Establish a post-market monitoring system that collects and analyses performance data over the system's life.

controls.title: Serious incident reporting procedure
controls.remedy: Write and test the procedure for reporting serious incidents to the market surveillance authority.

controls.title: Deployer obligations
controls.requires: present(evidence.deployer_controls) and evidence.deployer_controls.values.uses_per_instructions == true and evidence.deployer_controls.values.oversight_assigned == true and evidence.deployer_controls.values.log_retention_days >= 180
controls.remedy: Use the system per its instructions, assign trained people to oversight, and keep the logs you control for at least 180 days.

controls.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
controls.applies: system.risk_class == "high" and system.role in ["deployer", "both"] and system.fria_scope == true
controls.remedy: Complete a fundamental rights impact assessment before first use and update it when the facts change.

controls.title: AI literacy of staff
controls.remedy: Give the people who operate or use the system training suited to their role and record it.

controls.title: People are told they are dealing with an AI
controls.remedy: Tell people at the start that they are interacting with an AI system, unless it is obvious from the context.

controls.title: Synthetic content is marked machine-readably
controls.remedy: Mark generated audio, image, video or text in a machine-readable format so it can be detected as artificial.

controls.title: General-purpose model documentation
controls.remedy: Keep technical documentation for the AI Office and give downstream providers the information they need to comply.

controls.title: Copyright policy and training content summary
controls.remedy: Adopt a policy to comply with EU copyright law and publish the summary of training content.

controls.title: Systemic-risk model obligations
controls.applies: system.gpai == true and system.systemic_risk == true and system.role in ["provider", "both"]
controls.requires: present(evidence.gpai_systemic_risk) and evidence.gpai_systemic_risk.values.model_evaluation == true and evidence.gpai_systemic_risk.values.adversarial_testing == true and evidence.gpai_systemic_risk.values.incident_tracking == true and evidence.gpai_systemic_risk.values.cybersecurity_protection == true
controls.remedy: Evaluate the model, run adversarial testing, track and report serious incidents, and protect the model and its infrastructure.
